## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` is green
- [ ] New logic has tests
- [ ] New UI text goes through `t()` / `tr()` with a German translation
- [ ] [Codemap](../docs/CODEMAP.md) updated (new file, new module or changed flow)
- [ ] For a fundamental decision: ADR in `docs/adr/`
- [ ] No secrets, server addresses or personal data in the diff
